snippet.title: Sails Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Sails is a multiplayer survival game set in a brutal, living Caribbean where players fight, build, and sail their way to power. Start with nothing, gather resources, craft gear, trade, and build your own ship, then take to the open sea for naval combat, boarding battles, and exploration across dangerous waters.

Every region tells a different story. Raid colonial empires, visit tribal villages, and plunder settlements for loot. Whether you're raiding settlements, hunting treasure, or surviving against other players, the world is constantly pushing back.

Steam link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794620?utm_source=SocialMedia&utm_campaign=trailerv2&utm_medium=youtube

Music by @skyemaxilian
